name: Bitcoin / US dollar (Bitstamp exchange data)
notes: Same assumed trading terms as BTCUSD; the price series comes from Bitstamp's public API (true BTC/USD, UTC, 1m-1d) and is archived under the symbol BTCUSD-BITSTAMP in the separate intraday archive. Trades every day, so 'daily gaps' are weekend-free; exchange outages and extreme moves are possible; assumed retail fees (0.1 %). Broker terms unverified. gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight g
